title: BÀI TẬP THÌ TƯƠNG LAI ĐƠN

exercise_groups.group_title: 1. Bài 1: Cho Dạng Đúng Của Động Từ Trong Ngoặc
exercise_groups.instruction: Chia động từ ở thì Tương lai đơn (will + V0):

questions.prompt: 1. They (do) [blank] it for you tomorrow.
questions.explanation: Có tomorrow ➔ will do.

questions.prompt: 2. My father (call) [blank] you in 5 minutes.
questions.explanation: Có in 5 minutes ➔ will call.

questions.prompt: 3. We believe that she (recover) [blank] from her illness soon.
questions.explanation: Dự đoán tương lai ➔ will recover.

questions.prompt: 4. I promise I (return) [blank] school on time.
questions.explanation: Lời hứa (promise) ➔ will return.

questions.prompt: 5. If it rains, he (stay) [blank] at home.
questions.explanation: Mệnh đề chính câu điều kiện loại 1 ➔ will stay.

questions.prompt: 6. [blank] you (take) [blank] me to the zoo this weekend?
questions.explanation: Câu hỏi yêu cầu ➔ Will you take...?

questions.prompt: 7. I think he (not come) [blank] back to his hometown.
questions.explanation: Phủ định tương lai đơn ➔ will not come / won't come.

exercise_groups.group_title: 2. Bài 2: Dùng Từ Gợi Ý Viết Thành Câu Hoàn Chỉnh
exercise_groups.instruction: Sắp xếp và chia động từ thành câu hoàn chỉnh:

questions.prompt: She/ hope/ that/ Mary/ come/ party/ tonight.
answers: She hopes that Mary will come to the party tonight.
She hopes that Mary will come to the party tonight
She hopes that Mary will come party tonight.
She hopes that Mary will come party tonight
questions.explanation: She hopes that Mary will come to the party tonight.

questions.prompt: I/ finish/ my report/ 2 days.
answers: I will finish my report in 2 days.
I will finish my report in 2 days
I'll finish my report in 2 days.
I will finish my report in two days.
questions.explanation: I will finish my report in 2 days.

questions.prompt: If/ you/ not/ study/ hard/,/ you/ not/ pass/ final/ exam.
answers: If you do not study hard, you will not pass the final exam.
If you don't study hard, you won't pass the final exam.
If you do not study hard, you will not pass final exam.
If you don't study hard, you won't pass final exam.
questions.explanation: If you don't study hard, you won't pass the final exam.

questions.prompt: You/ look/ tired,/ so/ I/ bring/ you/ something/ eat.
answers: You look tired, so I will bring you something to eat.
You look tired, so I'll bring you something to eat.
You look tired so I will bring you something to eat.
questions.explanation: You look tired, so I will bring you something to eat.

questions.prompt: you/ please/ give/ me/ lift/ station?
answers: Will you please give me a lift to the station?
Will you please give me a lift to the station
Could you please give me a lift to the station?
questions.explanation: Will you please give me a lift to the station?

exercise_groups.group_title: 3. Bài 3: Chia Động Từ Ở Dạng Phủ Định (Will not / Won't)
exercise_groups.instruction: Điền dạng phủ định chính xác 'will not' hoặc 'won't' kèm động từ nguyên mẫu:

questions.prompt: 1. Tomorrow it [blank] (not to rain) in the North.
questions.explanation: will not rain / won't rain.

questions.prompt: 2. Just a moment. I [blank] (not to help) you.
questions.explanation: will not help / won't help.

questions.prompt: 3. In 2030 there [blank] (not to be) more cars.
questions.explanation: will not be / won't be.

questions.prompt: 4. I think Dennis [blank] (not to like) this CD.
questions.explanation: will not like / won't like.

questions.prompt: 5. My friend [blank] (not to be) 12 next Wednesday.
questions.explanation: will not be / won't be.

questions.prompt: 6. I don't think the pupils [blank] (not to get) good marks in the test.
questions.explanation: will not get / won't get (hoặc will get nếu tính phủ định ở don't think).

questions.prompt: 7. I [blank] (not to see) you tonight.
questions.explanation: will not see / won't see.

questions.prompt: 8. People [blank] (not to buy) lots of cheap clothes.
questions.explanation: will not buy / won't buy.
